lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Wyrm of Ash coiled across the drowned causeway, steam rising where its scales met the water.

lines.speaker: Thorne Ironroot
lines.text: It should not be this far north. Ash wyrms die in the cold.

lines.speaker: Mira Frostwhisper
lines.text: Then it was brought here. Someone wanted the marsh burned.

lines.speaker: Kaelen Ashvow
lines.text: Questions after. Mira, slow it. Thorne, hold the causeway. I will take the head.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The wyrm's eye found Kaelen, and in it there was no hunger at all. Only recognition.
